item.title: How Epstein and Bannon tried to reshape EU politics, hated Merkel
item.description: The Epstein files show not only how he abused women and girls while mixing with powerful people, but also how he tried to influence politics in Europe.

item.title: THIS WEEK: EU leaders’ retreat on competitiveness, Munich Security Conference, and Ukraine
item.description: This week, EU leaders will meet in Alden Biesen to discuss economic reforms and competitiveness, while the Munich Security Conference takes place from Friday to Sunday. In Strasbourg, MEPs will vote on housing, defence, climate, migration, and Ukraine aid.

item.title: Listen: Can a European social platform compete with X?
item.description: After Elon Musk's X, could Europe finally build its own social media powerhouse? In this episode, Léa Marchal explores the “W” social media platform, Anna Zeiter’s bold alternative — its ambitions, challenges, and whether Europe can truly rival US tech giants.

item.title: EU leaders’ retreat needs to hear less about ‘deregulation’ from Draghi
item.description: Big and small European companies are most concerned about the lack of skilled staff. So why is this not a key topic at the EU leaders' retreat on 12 February in the Alden Biesen castle, when 'simplification' of legislation is?

item.title: EU Parliament set to adopt tougher asylum laws amid far-right pressure
item.description: New anti-asylum laws are likely to be rubber-stamped by the European Parliament on Tuesday, amid further alarm over the far-right influence on migration

item.title: Brussels warns WhatsApp to stop blocking alternative AI services
item.description: The European Commission has warned US tech giant Meta that it intends to implement measures to prevent a policy change on WhatsApp that would prevent third-party AI assistance — a move the executive sees as a potential antitrust violation.

item.title: Europe’s empty homes are the missing piece in the EU’s ‘Affordable Housing Plan’
item.description: Europe’s housing crisis is both social and environmental. Rents continue to rise, homelessness is increasing, and millions of households are trapped in energy poverty. Yet across the continent, a striking contradiction persists: entire buildings stand empty or under-used, even as people struggle to find a place they can afford to live in. item.title: Moscow spokeswoman mocks EU diplomat over freezing Kyiv conditions
item.description: The head of the EU delegation in Kyiv, Katarína Mathernová, says the Ukrainian capital is facing a winter humanitarian catastrophe, due to Russian attacks on the heating supplies.

item.title: EU says ‘concerns’ raised with UAE over its role in Sudan war
item.description: The EU says it has challenged the UAE over its role in Sudan's civil war, despite being in trade talks with Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Israel’s ‘de facto annexation’ of West Bank earns only mild EU rebuke
item.description: Israel pledged to "kill" the EU and UN-backed two-state solution to the Arab-Israeli conflict, as EU "condemned" new anti-Palestinian laws.
